title: Germany arrests former intelligence chief in espionage case - The Washington Post
description: August Hanning is accused of selling state secrets to at least one foreign state. It could be the worst breach at the German foreign intelligence agency since the Cold War’s end.

title: Xbox has secured exclusive GTA 6 streaming rights - The Verge
description: The streaming rights come in November, when Microsoft is opening up access to Xbox Cloud Gaming.

title: Roberts moves struggling Ohtani to No. 5 spot for NLDS Game 3 - ESPN
description: Manager Dave Roberts juggled the Dodgers' lineup for Game 3 of the NL Division Series against the Braves, moving DH Shohei Ohtani to the No. 5 spot.

title: Apple’s Smart Home Push Includes Doorbell, Lock, Thermostat Codeveloped With LG - Bloomberg.com
description: Apple Inc.’s upcoming push into smart home devices will include a doorbell, thermostat and other accessories developed through an unusual partnership with LG Electronics Inc.
